description: This PHP source file defines the class LeadsListViewSmarty, which extends the base ListViewSmarty class to customize the list view for leads in a CRM system. It includes methods for processing list view data, building export links, and handling certain configurations related to delivery and export of lead data.

classes.name: LeadsListViewSmarty
classes.description: A custom list view class for leads in the CRM, extending the ListViewSmarty base class to include additional features like export link construction and opt-in confirmation options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class and sets the targetList property to true.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the list view data, adding optional actions based on configuration, and controls export link visibility.

methods.name: buildExportLink
methods.description: Builds an export link with JavaScript onclick behavior, guarded by access rights, and appends a map link for list view interaction.
